locationMethod: Exact source-mask-zero 20m sample coordinates, inverse of app local geographic projection. Bounds enclose missing samples, not continuous missing rectangles.
recoveryMethod: Official HTTPS tile URLs downloaded with Windows curl/Schannel standard TLS; no certificate bypass. DEM5A first, official DEM5B/DEM10B fallback. Requires four valid source corners per 20m sample. Original TLS failure cause not established.
remainingMethod: Source-mask-zero samples filled by nearest valid sample and smoothing, explicitly labelled interpolation. No survey measurement or invented source controls.
